# Math Worksheet Studio

> Free printable mathematics practice generators. Create worksheets and matching answer-key PDFs in your browser without a student account.

Math Worksheet Studio provides focused mathematics practice tools, printable worksheets, and answer keys. This file is a compact guide to the site's main resources for language models and other automated readers.

## Main pages

- [Math Worksheet Studio home](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/): Overview of the free worksheet generators and how to use them.
- [All worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/worksheets/): Browse the published worksheet tools and subject areas.
- [About, methods, and accuracy policy](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/about/): Read how worksheet questions, answers, and quality checks are handled.
- [Contact and corrections](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/contact/): Report a suspected question, answer, or content error.
- [Privacy policy](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/privacy/): Review the site's privacy information.
- [Terms of use](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/terms/): Review the site's terms.
- [Public source repository](https://github.com/garrison2025/Math_Works): Inspect the implementation and automated quality checks.

## Subject directories

- [Arithmetic worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/arithmetic/): Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and number skills.
- [Fraction worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/fractions/): Fraction practice and related skills.
- [Algebra worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/algebra/): Equations, functions, and algebraic reasoning.
- [Geometry worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/geometry/): Angles, measurement, area, volume, and geometric reasoning.
- [Data and statistics worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/data-statistics/): Data displays and statistical measures.
- [Suggested grade pathways](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/worksheets-by-grade/): Browse suggested practice by grade; these pathways are not a certification of full curriculum coverage.
- [Original math word problems](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/word-problems-worksheets/): Practice applying mathematics in written problems.

## Focused tools and learning guides

- [Two-step equations worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/two-step-equations-worksheets/): Solve equations using inverse operations and check solutions.
- [Long division worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/long-division-worksheets/): Practice quotient, remainder, and written division steps.
- [Adding unlike fractions worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/adding-unlike-fractions-worksheets/): Find common denominators and add fractions.
- [Triangle area worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/area-of-triangles-worksheets/): Calculate area using base and perpendicular height.
- [Surface area worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/surface-area-worksheets/): Find the surface area of supported three-dimensional shapes.
- [Rectangular-prism volume worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/volume-of-rectangular-prisms-worksheets/): Calculate volume and solve supported missing-dimension problems.
- [Box plot worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/box-plots-worksheets/): Read and construct box plots using the site's stated quartile convention.
- [Printable protractor](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/printable-protractor/): Print an angle-measuring tool and verify its calibration line.
- [Equivalent fractions worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/equivalent-fractions-worksheets/): Identify and generate equivalent fractions.
- [Mean, median, mode, and range worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/mean-median-mode-range-worksheets/): Practice common measures of center and spread.
- [Multiplication worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/multiplication-worksheets/): Generate focused multiplication practice.
- [Mixed addition and subtraction worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/mixed-addition-subtraction-worksheets/): Practice mixed addition and subtraction, including regrouping.
- [Pythagorean theorem worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/pythagorean-worksheets/): Practice finding a missing side in right triangles.
- [Multiplication tables worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/multiplication-tables-worksheets/): Practice multiplication facts and tables.
- [Subtraction worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/subtraction-worksheets/): Practice multi-digit subtraction and regrouping.
- [One-step equations worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/one-step-equations-worksheets/): Solve one-step equations and verify the result.
- [Decimal multiplication worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/decimal-multiplication-worksheets/): Multiply decimals and place the decimal point correctly.
- [Fraction operations worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/fractions-worksheets/): Practice the fraction operations supported by the generator.
- [Two-digit multiplication worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/two-digit-multiplication-worksheets/): Practice two-digit multiplication with aligned written work.
- [Order of operations worksheets](https://mathworksheetstudio.com/order-of-operations-worksheets/): Apply grouping symbols and operation precedence.

## How to interpret the resources

- The site has 51 core topic generators, plus separate original mixed-skill and word-problem tools.
- A worksheet and its separate answer key are generated from the same topic settings. The topic, selected options, generator version, and random seed are used to reproduce the same question set.
- Worked solutions are available only on topics where the feature is implemented; do not assume every generator provides step-by-step explanations.
- Grade pathways are suggestions, not certified curriculum coverage, official standards alignment, or test-preparation endorsements.
- Box plots use the exclusive median-of-halves quartile convention described on the relevant page.
- For the printable protractor, print at 100% scale and measure the 50 mm calibration line with a ruler before use.
- The public repository documents implementation and automated checks; it does not imply independent teacher approval.
- When reporting an error, include the page, problem number, settings, seed, and expected answer. Do not include student personal information.

This navigation file supplements the human-readable pages. It does not replace the canonical HTML pages, robots.txt, or sitemap.xml.
